tabs.tab1_description:
5 Mukhi Nepalese Rudraksha is the most abundantly available rudraksha bead. The 5 mukhi rudraksha bead symbolizes Lord Kalagni Rudra, one of the fierce manifestations of Lord Shiva which makes the wearer to get rid of this life karma. In Vedic Astrology, 5 mukhi Rudraksha is associated with Jupiter which makes 5 mukhi to be a guiding bead in our path, by providing the knowledge we need. The wearer of this Rudraksha gets purged of their sins, realigned with their life purpose, has their wishes granted, and reaches a place of happiness in their lives. This is the most popular rudraksha bead used to create wearable malas. It appears like Lord Shiva wanted it to be worn by humankind in order to raise the level of consciousness, given its abundant availability by Shakti or Mother Earth. Popularly known as Paanch mukhi Rudraksh, it also symbolizes de 5 forms of Shiva the Supreme, which represent the 5 elements of nature, namely Ishana, Tatpurusha, Aghora, Vamadeva and Sadyojatha. Lord Kalagni Rudra destroys sins of devotees thereby purifying them and enabling them to complete their entire life cycle. This rudraksha creates a protective cocoon around the wearer so he or she is safe from negative influences. It is worn around the neck by children in the Gurukul system (Indian traditional educational system between guru and its students) for guru guidance and protection. This rudraksha is also the most extensively used for chanting mantras, japa and yoga practices, and invoking all gods and goddesses.

Scriptural Reference of 5 Mukhi Rudraksha

Shiva Purana. Chapter 25, Slokas 69-70.

Panchavaktrah svayam rudrah kala-agnir namatah prabhu | 
Sarvamuktipradashchaiva sarvakamafalapradah || 69 ||
Five faced Rudraksha is the form of Lord Kala-agni Rudra. This Rudraksha delivers all liberation and fulfills all wishes. 

Agamyagamanam papamabhakshayasya cha bhakshanam |
Ityadisarvapapani panchavaktro vyapohati || 70 ||
Sins arising from adultery and consuming uneatable foods are rinsed by five faced Rudraksha 

Padma Purana, Chapter 57

पञ्चवक्त्रं तु रुद्राक्षं कालाग्निं पापनाशनम्।

Translation: The five-faced Rudraksha is Kalagni, destroyer of sins.

5 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha is available in a variety of sizes, including: small, regular, large and collector. The bigger the size of the rudraksha the faster the results. This is because the seeds are bigger and the surface area in contact with skin is larger, thus, energy is dispersed more quickly throughout the body.

However, many people prefer Java beads because they are smaller and can be worn as alluring jewellery. It is up to the individual to decide.

However, it is recommended to briefly remove the Rudraksha combination so that soap or other chemicals do not become trapped in the Rudraksha's grooves.

tabs.tab4_description:
How to identify original 5 Mukhi Nepal Rudraksha?

Some fraudulent tests have gained popularity and must be avoided because their results are unreliable and they cannot be used to determine the authenticity of Rudraksha.

The Fake tests are the Water Test, Milk test or Copper Coin Rotation Test. All these tests are unscientific and produce untrustworthy results.

One way to determine the originality of Rudraksha beads is to take an X-ray. In an X-ray, the compartment and seeds inside the Rudraksha are observable, and their number should ideally correspond to the number of Mukhi lines on the bead. Sometimes all seeds are not visible as they get compressed during formation and compartments are very close to each other, though.

Experts at Rudra Centre can examine the bead and determine if they are original or not. You can send us images and videos of your Rudraksha at the email: contact@rudracentre.com for our experts to determine authenticity.

In recent years many labs have emerged which offer Rudraksha certification however these are highly unreliable because they do not have the right knowledge and many times make mistakes in identifying Rudraksha beads. Many traders are using these labs to issue fake certificates. These labs are not able to distinguish manipulated beads where extra lines are carved on the Rudraksha to make it a higher mukhi which costs more. Also, they do not reject beads with incomplete mukhi lines which actually don’t give results. These labs are not affiliated with any central body or government, so they do not have any credibility. Hence to protect consumers Rudra Centre has opened its own laboratory and have started issuing genuine certificate where all parameters of the Rudraksha are analyzed. We examine whether the beads are healthy, whether the mukhi lines are complete, and whether the rudraksha beads has been manipulated.

At Rudra Centre, we issue certificates for all beads procured from us. If you want an X-ray certificate for the Rudraksha bead, then an additional INR 500 is charged per Rudraksha bead.

How to Clean & Maintain 5 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha?

Rudraksha beads can last a lifetime and be passed down through generations if cared for properly.

In cold and dry climates, rudraksha beads may develop surface-level cracks, in which case any natural unscented oil may be applied, such as olive oil, sandal oil, or cow ghee.

Rudraksha may develop molds and insects if they are kept in a humid place and unused for a long time, in this case follow the below steps:

  • Dip the Rudraksha beads in lukewarm water for 15 mins.
  • Clean any molds visible of the surface using a toothbrush.
  • Dry them under the shade of the Sun (indirect Sunlight) or you can also use a dryer or hairdryer.
  • After following the above steps, you can start wearing your rudraksha beads or combination again.

Follow the steps below to regularly clean your Rudraksha beads:

  • Wash Rudraksha beads under running water.
  • Scrub the surface of the rudraksha to remove any dust particles caught in the grooves, using a toothbrush.
  • Use the shade of the Sun (indirect sunlight) or a hairdryer to dry the beads.
  • Apply any natural and unscented oil like Olive oil, Almond oil or Sandal oil.
  • If you are planning to not wear beads for a long duration, it is advisable to keep them in the fridge.
  • Do not use any chemical cleaner or insecticide or pesticide to clean or treat your Rudraksha.
  • Do not put your rudraksha beads in boiling water or extremely hot water.

5 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha Health & Color

5 Mukhi Nepal Rudraksha will become darker overtime with usage because it is exposed to oil, sweat and the environment, this is a natural process and doesn’t affect the energy of the Rudraksha bead. It is best to choose a light Sandy Brown to Brown color Rudraksha bead as it generally means the bead is healthy and freshly (recently) harvested. It is advised to avoid wearing dark black or dark grey color beads as they may be lifeless. To check if the bead is healthy and alive just shake the bead well and if you hear the seeds inside rattling then it means that the bead is lifeless or dead and if there is no rattling sound then the bead is healthy and alive. You can inspect the bead from all sides and look inside the natural hole to ensure that there are no white color molds or insects which have infested the bead. Sometimes the soap gets stuck in the grooves, which are white in color; therefore, you should determine whether the white deposits are soap or mold. The mold will appear as threads whereas the soap deposits will be like a cream or paste. The energy of the Rudraksha beads resides is in its seeds, thus we must ensure that the seeds are healthy and alive.
